scope: Fresh structured-MCP transport cohort with unchanged full architecture policies, profile snapshots, source fixture and semantic contract. All previous Astra/Sol shell-transport failures remain held and unpooled. No replacement of any sample.
manual_criteria: All stated needs covered without invented profile facts.
One design, no alternative recommendation list.
No-profile case uses an explicit honest assumption.
ADR candidates agree exactly with expressed architecture intent.
Non-build recommendations remain human-only and perform no procurement.
Every produced artifact is read; all hashes and native metadata bind the same frozen cohort.
candidate_launch_requires: Recorded passing five-baseline source/native/semantic/manual and real-consumer gate. The generic runner does not enforce this external prerequisite.
source_installation_requires: Five baseline samples must pass native replay, all four artifacts and ten decisions, actual contract/profile consumption and independent manual review before any candidate launch. Then require the same five candidate samples. Freeze all inputs, preserve every failure and stop on a failed sample. Final replay consumes all forty actual artifacts with the real CLI and rejects invalid recommendations. Integration and main lint/inventory precede acceptance. No full graft, profile acquisition, architectural quality, procurement or ADR creation claim.
